title: Senior User Experience Designer - Sap Concur Travel
description:
Senior User Experience Designer - SAP Concur Travel

We help the world run better At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

As the world’s leading provider of integrated travel and expense management solutions, SAP Concur is driven by a relentless pursuit to simplify and automate these everyday processes. At the heart of this is our commitment to the User Experience and we see the impact research, design and data has on improving experiences every day.

As our commitment to UX grows we are looking for a Senior UX Designer in the Travel UX team. You will be responsible for your work and accompany your concepts throughout the development life cycle, and you are continuously broadening your horizon on design methods and technologies. You work in partnership with our extended global product teams to develop simple and intuitive user experiences for our customers and millions of users around the world.

Who are you
  • A natural collaborator and communicator: you are able to develop and present design ideas in a large team environment.
  • Prior experience working within a technical environment is a key requirement.
  • You possess strong experience and interaction design skills, as well as comprehensive knowledge of user-centered design principles.
  • You have an affinity for consistency and a keen eye for subtle details.
  • You are able to grasp and distill complex issues and translate them into clean, focused, understandable solutions.
  • You’ll work closely with Design Systems and Accessibility teams to ensure consistent and accessible design solutions.
  • You should be a self-starter, self-motivated, able to work independently, and perform multiple tasks under minimal supervision.
Work Experience and Qualifications
  • Solid corporate work experience with a focus on software design across a variety of platforms.
  • A great eye for detail, demonstrated creative and innovative problem-solving skills.
  • Experience designing UI products from conception to completion from the discovery through to the development process.
  • Ability to clearly communicate concepts and designs through sketches, wireframes, high fidelity comps, and prototypes.
  • Able to function both independently and in a team environment with solid collaboration skills.
  • Enthusiasm and history working in an iterative design process, motivated by group critique.
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to articulate design work to large groups and stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Human Computer Interaction, Graphic Design, Media Arts or other relevant experience.
  • Experience designing and prototyping in Figma.
  • Experience in mobile app and component design.
  • Experience in designing for accessibility.
  • You have a portfolio that displays a spectrum of creative design solutions.
Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta.

A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. title: Head Of Brand, Marketing And Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.
Your Profile
  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
Additional Information
  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at FIFA Women’s World Cup™ by 2x.

title: Coordenador(A) De Atendimento De Pr – Setor Farmacêutico
description:
Coordenador(a) de Atendimento de PR – Setor Farmacêutico

Quem Somos Somos a Ideal Axicom, uma premiada agência de comunicação global para marcas de tecnologia e que queiram contar histórias de inovação. Reunimos uma equipe diversificada de profissionais de comunicação apaixonados por comunicação integrada e por contar histórias transformadoras. Com escritórios na Holanda, Estados Unidos, Reino Unido, Espanha, Itália, Alemanha, França, Suécia, Brasil e México, somos a maior agência global especializada em comunicação tecnológica.

Who We Are We are Axicom, an award‑winning global communications agency for tech‑driven brands. We bring together a diverse team of PR professionals passionate about integrated communications and telling the transformative stories of technology. With offices in the Netherlands, United States, United Kingdom, Spain, Italy, Germany, France, Sweden, Brazil, and Mexico, we are the largest global agency specializing in tech communication. We’re proud to be recently recognized as Agency of the Future, Disruptive Agency of the Year, and Best PR Network to Work For (EMEA). This underscores our commitment to innovation, growth, and fostering a collaborative culture. Since 1994, we’ve delivered ground‑breaking campaigns for the world’s most innovative tech companies, and we are always seeking new talent to join our team of Futurists.

Mais Sobre a função Buscamos um Coordenador de Relações Públicas para atuar com cliente do Setor Farmacêutico, no formato híbrido, em nosso escritório em São Paulo. Você terá a oportunidade de criar e executar estratégias que impulsionam o desenvolvimento de marcas inovadoras, em um ambiente dinâmico e de constante evolução.

O Que Fará
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos efetivos e estratégicos com o cliente, compreendendo profundamente seus negócios, produtos, desafios regulatórios e objetivos de comunicação.
  • Atuar como conselheiro(a) de confiança, oferecendo recomendações proativas e atualizações regulares sobre o progresso das iniciativas de comunicação, sempre alinhadas às diretrizes regulatórias e científicas.
  • Antecipar necessidades e potenciais problemas dos clientes, com atenção especial a compliance, riscos regulatórios e sensibilidades do setor;
    sinalizando-os à gestãoe propondo soluções estratégicas para superar desafios, conquistar relevância e atingir KPIs da comunicação.
  • Elaborar propostas, documentos de planejamento de comunicação e estratégias de divulgação para os principais lançamentos (de produtos, estudos, etc.), eventos e campanhas, com rigor técnico e aderência às normas do setor.
  • Gerenciar a rentabilidade e o orçamento dos projetos/contas, trabalhando com os contatos do cliente para gerenciar expectativas e cumprir os principais objetivos e manter a satisfação do cliente.
  • Gerenciar e mentorar a equipe de Atendimento (Sênior e Júnior), sendo responsável pela alocação diária de horas para garantir que as metas de utilização sejam cumpridas.
  • Fornecer feedbacks construtivos, coletar análise de desempenho e realizar análises trimestrais e semestrais de desempenho.
  • Trabalhar com os Atendimentos para definir e implementar metas de desenvolvimento profissional da equipe e também dos clientes;
    distribuir as tarefas internamente e responsabilizar os membros da equipe pelo cumprimento desses objetivos.
  • Manter um alto padrão de atendimento ao cliente, trabalho de qualidade e satisfação dos prazos do projeto, com foco nas especificidades do setor farmacêutico.
  • Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento profissional da equipe, ajudando os atendimentos a aumentar sua experiência no setor farmacêutico e seu desenvolvimento/reconhecimento pessoal na Ideal Axicom.
  • Gerenciar – e contribuir para – a execução de campanhas, programas e eventos do cliente, com estrita observância das normas regulatórias (ex: ANVISA) e códigos de ética do setor farmacêutico.
  • Atuar com profundo conhecimento da comunicação científica e de saúde, das mídias estabelecidas e das novas mídias.
  • Construir e manter relacionamento com jornalistas da mídia tier, especialmente aqueles especializados em saúde, ciência e negócios do setor farmacêutico.
  • Revisar e Gerenciar a entrega de relatórios de resultados, a partir de avaliação macro e estratégica da apresentação dos dados em relação aos KPIs e objetivos prioritários dos clientes traçados para a comunicação e/ou campanhas específicas.
  • Atuar perto e em colaboração com os clientes e com a equipe da conta, designando os membros da equipe com conhecimentos equivalente para atender às necessidades específicas de cada projeto/entrega.
  • Atuar com protagonismo no processo de integração das diferentes áreas internas da agência, reforçando nosso conceito de que tudo é PR, e como isso se aplica de forma especial ao setor farmacêutico.
  • Participar ativamente de processos de novos negócios, contribuindo para a estratégia de concorrências, auxiliando em brainstorms da equipe para gerar ideias criativas e apresentando ativamente para os clientes em potencial para vender os serviços da Ideal Axicom, destacando nossa expertise farmacêutica.
Experiência Que Contribui Para o Sucesso
  • Experiência comprovada e INDISPENSÁVEL no atendimento a clientes do setor farmacêutico/saúde em agências de PR/comunicação.
  • Experiência robusta e conhecimento aprofundado em assuntos regulatórios (ANVISA) e compliance para a comunicação farmacêutica.
  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente
  • Sólida visão estratégica e de negócios, com capacidade de aplicá-la ao rigoroso contexto farmacêutico.
  • Experiência com gestão de equipe (nível Sênior e Júnior) e múltiplos clientes/projetos simultâneos.
  • Familiaridade com comunicação científica, saúde e relações com stakeholders do setor (médicos, pacientes, associações, órgãos reguladores).
  • Habilidade na construção e manutenção de mailing de imprensa especializada em saúde e negócios farmacêuticos.
  • Excepcional capacidade de comunicação, negociação e apresentação, sempre com rigor técnico, ético e atenção aos detalhes exigidos pelo setor.
  • Perfil proativo, criativo, resiliente e com forte senso de responsabilidade e compliance.
Você Pertence à Axicom

Nossa visão é que a Axicom, uma empresa do Grupo Burson, seja a principal ‘empresa‑escola’ para profissionais de comunicação criativa e líderes emergentes. Oferecemos um ambiente dinâmico onde colegas ambiciosos aprimoram suas habilidades, expandem suas redes e, por fim, produzem as melhores soluções para as marcas líderes da atualidade. Nosso compromisso com o seu crescimento se reflete em nossos robustos programas de benefícios e desenvolvimento de talentos, que incluem oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional, programas de mentoria com líderes do setor, uma cultura empresarial vibrante e inclusiva que promove a colaboração e a inovação, além de pacotes projetados para recompensar e reter os melhores talentos. Investimos em nossos colaboradores porque acreditamos que o sucesso deles é o nosso sucesso.

Na Axicom, acreditamos no aprendizado constante. Reconhecemos que as coisas que fazemos de melhor, criatividade e comunicação, exigem um alto nível de nuance e compreensão. Por isso, é fundamental contratarmos pessoas extraordinariamente talentosas de todas as origens e identidades. Sem isso, não podemos realizar o trabalho essencial de inspirar ideias ousadas, fomentar o diálogo construtivo, cultivar experiências significativas e impulsionar a inovação e a criatividade para nossos parceiros. Seu ponto de vista único — seu talento — é o que faz de você uma #BursonPerson, e é como entregamos resultados excepcionais para nossos clientes, juntos.

Acreditamos que o melhor trabalho acontece quando estamos juntos, fomentando a criatividade, a colaboração e a conexão. É por isso que adotamos uma abordagem híbrida, com equipes no escritório cerca de quatro dias por semana. Se precisar de acomodações ou flexibilidade, converse com a equipe de contratação durante o processo de entrevista.

Ao clicar no botão “Enviar Candidatura” abaixo, todas as informações que você adicionar serão enviadas para a Burson. Antes de fazer isso, achamos uma boa ideia ler nossa Política de Privacidade de Recrutamento. Residentes da Califórnia devem ler nosso Aviso de Privacidade de Recrutamento da Califórnia. Ele explica o que fazemos com seus dados pessoais quando você se candidata a uma vaga conosco e como você pode atualizar as informações que nos forneceu ou como removê-las.

You Belong At Axicom

Our vision is for Axicom, a Burson Group company, to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Axicom, we’re an agency of learn‑it‑alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent— is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we’re together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That’s why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

title: Head Of Brand - Brasil
description:
Job Description

Location: São Paulo, Brasil

Type of contract: Full time

About Luzia

Luzia is LATAM’s fastest-growing consumer AI company, backed by world-class investors including Khosla Ventures, A*, Monashees, Prosus and Sequoia. Our mission is to redefine what conversational AI can do by leveraging cutting-edge large language models (LLMs) and advanced alignment techniques to create intuitive, human-like digital assistants.

Just two years after launch, Luzia is already woven into the daily lives of millions of Brazilians. We’re now deepening our roots here at home, bringing even more local flavor and warmth to everything we build. Join us and help shape Luzia’s voice and product for Brazil from day one.

The Role

As our Head of Brand in Brazil, you’ll build on Luzia’s existing brand foundation and bring it to life locally, adding the cultural nuance and emotional depth that resonates with Brazilian users. You’ll craft a distinctive, human brand presence that feels both consistent with our global identity and uniquely relevant to the local market. You’ll lead the charge in shaping how millions of people experience and connect with Luzia, working cross-functionally to build a brand that drives love, loyalty, and organic growth — positioning Luzia as the most trusted and beloved AI assistant in one of our most important markets.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and define Luzia’s brand in Brazil— identity, and voice to reflect the cultural context, emotional tone, and everyday realities of our Brazilian audience.

  • Create emotional connections with users— craft narratives, campaigns, and experiences that go beyond utility and build lasting emotional bonds with millions of users.

  • Champion brand consistency— ensure a unified voice and visual identity across all touchpoints: product, marketing, tech, and talent.

  • Manage Public Relations and storytelling efforts— partner with Brazilian agencies and internal teams to build earned local media strategies and tell stories that resonate with both mainstream and underserved communities.

  • Collaborate across teams— work hand-in-hand with product, growth, comms, and design to bring brand ideas to life and make sure everyone internally is aligned around a clear brand mission.

  • Translate insight into impact —lead research efforts on market positioning, user sentiment, and competitive dynamics in Brazil, acting as the closest voice to our users and ensuring their needs, culture, and perspective shape brand decisions at every level.

  • Use content and influencers as strategic tools— partner with local creators, ambassadors, and users to grow organic reach and relevance.

  • Drive organic brand growth — focus on strategies that scale awareness and engagement through word-of-mouth, content, SEO, and product-led storytelling — not just paid media.

  • Manage budgets and agency partners— oversee brand-related investments, including agency collaborations ensuring high return and aligned execution.

What We’re Looking For

  • A strategic brand builder who’s done this before in Brazil— ideally in a high-growth consumer tech company or strong brand-led startup.

  • Deep experience in brand, mobile, and PR— you know what it takes to launch and scale brand presence in the Brazilian market.

  • A strategic operator— able to zoom out and set long-term direction, while also rolling up your sleeves to execute or manage projects day-to-day.

  • Stay deeply connected to our audience— read comments and reviews, engage directly with users, and immerse in the behaviors, trends, and desires of Brazilian young adults to continuously adapt our messaging and brand voice.

  • Obsessed with the user— you’re constantly engaging with users and deeply in tune with Gen Z and Millennials, our core audience. You draw insight from their behaviors, language, and culture to craft brand experiences and messaging that genuinely resonate.

  • A storyteller at heart— with a gift for creating narratives that spark curiosity, trust, and emotion.

  • Fluent in visual and emotional branding— with strong creative sensibility and the ability to direct top-tier brand work.

  • Collaborative to the core— able to inspire teams, work across functions, and align stakeholders behind the brand vision.

  • Analytically sharp and resource-savvy— focused on high-impact, measurable initiatives and able to prioritize what moves the needle.

  • Tuned-in to Gen Z & Millennials— you intuitively speak their language, tap their cultural cues, and craft experiences that land with Brazil’s digital-native generations.

  • AI-savvy experimenter— eager to explore, question, and ship breakthrough AI features that put cutting-edge tech directly in users’ hands.

  • Fluency in English is required;
    Spanish is a plus.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working at a tech startup or fast-scaling mobile app in Brazil.

  • Track record of working closely with product and growth teams to align brand and user experience.

  • Ability to balance instinct and data — you know when to trust the numbers and when to lead with bold intuition.

Why Join Luzia?

At Luzia, you’ll help shape one of the most exciting consumer AI products in the world. We move fast, stay humble, and keep users at the center of everything we do. If you\ 're passionate about AI, thrive in dynamic environments, and want your work to impact millions of people, we’d love to meet you.

Our Culture & Values

We’re builders at heart — driven by data, experimentation, and velocity. Our team lives by a “ship, learn, iterate” mentality, constantly pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. At Luzia, autonomy meets accountability in an environment where ideas win and learning never stops.

Your Impact

In this role, you won’t just be building a product — you’ll be helping define a category. The work you do will shape how millions of people interact with AI every day, and help chart Luzia’s course in one of our most important markets.

Design Director, UI/UX & Brand

Join to apply for the Design Director, UI/UX & Brand role at Darkroom

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior‑level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e‑commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities
  • Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.
  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.
  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.
Management Responsibilities
  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high‑quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.
  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.
You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You
  • 3-6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e-commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.
  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.
  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.
  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.
Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.
Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Job description

Somos aERO,uma mineradora que nasceu no coração do Brasil e cresceu levando para o mundo mais força e energia — uma força que impulsiona setores produtivos e contribui para o desenvolvimento de diferentes regiões.

Desde 1979, quando iniciou suas atividades na unidade Caraíba, a empresa vem consolidando sua presença no setor mineral brasileiro, expandindo para a mina de ouro em Xavantina, avançando na implantação da unidade Tucumã— que se destaca como um dos principais polosde produção de cobre do país. Nosso crescimento é movido pela experiência em exploração, que nos ajuda a expandir a vida útil de nossas minas e a avançar em novos projetos, como o Projeto Furnas, no Pará.

Nosso jeito de fazer mineração é guiado por valores sólidos: cuidado, coragem, honestidade, colaboração e excelência. Esses princípios estão no centro de tudo o que fazemos — desde o chão da mina até as decisões estratégicas. E eles também orientam como cuidamos do crescimento de cada pessoa na Ero.

O nosso objetivo é claro: ser a melhor empresa de mineração do Brasil, e sabemos que isso só é possível investindo nas pessoas que constroem esse futuro com a gente, todos os dias.

Se identificou?

Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como Técnico de Geologia I que será responsável por acompanhar as atividades de geologia de mina, sempre fazendo a intermediação entre a parte operacional e geólogos, assegurando a conformidade com normas internacionais e promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua e excelência operacional.

title: Director, Hematology Medical Engagement Lead (Mel) Intercontinental Region
description:
Working with Us Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high‑achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: careers.Bms.Com/working-with-us.

A BMS acredita que ter uma equipe diversificada de funcionários e uma cultura de inclusão é vital para a inovação e para executar de forma bem-sucedida nossa estratégia de negócios BioPharma. Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PCD), assim como para as demais dimensões no sentido mais amplo da diversidade, como gênero, idade, etnia, raça, orientação sexual & identidades, habilidades físicas, aparência, religião, origem socioeconômica, estilos de pensamento e experiências de vida.

Role Overview

The primary role of MEL is to engage in meaningful peer‑to‑peer scientific dialog with healthcare system Regional/International Thought Leaders (RTLs) within Intercontinental Region Countries (mainly Brazil, Latin America including Puerto Rico, Canada, Turkey, KSA&Gulf and Israel). The MEL conducts critical activities that support advancing science, educating on evolving clinical practices, transforming science into patient care, and facilitating the development of new research collaborations (including Collaborative and Investigator‑led Trials and Real‑World Evidence). The role collaborates with colleagues on capturing medical insights and acts as a therapeutic area resource to cross‑functional partners. Engagement with TLs should be aligned with medical strategies, and the role should provide insight back to home office/global teams to inform regional and global strategy.

This role is field‑based and regional in scope. It is anticipated that the employee will spend ~ 50 to 70% of the time in the field interacting with external stakeholders, including investigators and clinical thought leaders while supporting internal stakeholders and maintaining a high level of therapeutic expertise.

External Scientific Exchange & Medical Strategy Advisory
  • Engaging in high-quality peer-to-peer scientific dialog with key Intercontinental Thought Leaders (TLs) in Hematology focused on pre- and peri-launch period.
  • Collaborates with Intercontinental Thought Leaders to identify and generate insights on evolving care paradigms to inform medical strategy.
  • Provides strategic input into education and communication materials, including conference symposia.
  • Provides strategic input into regional access and reimbursement strategy.
  • Serves as subject matter expert for internal education for key strategic team members of GPT and other governance bodies, commercialization cross-functional teams, WW medical team and Local Medical Teams.
  • Whenever needed support the regional clinical trial execution strategy especially for the priority trials.
Evidence Facilitation
  • Facilitates scientific partnerships and research collaborations with Global and Local medical teams, and other WW functions such as the Global Development Team (GDD).
  • Provides recommendations and insights to the clinical development team on study feasibilities and site selection within the therapeutic area based on knowledge of the field and through direct contacts with potential investigators, as agreed with home office medical and Global Development Operations (GDO).
  • Provides recommendations and insights to build best evidence generation plan to address specific regional gaps (incl. access and reimbursement needs).
  • Proactively discusses BMS major evidence readouts to investigators partnering with GDD. Reactively discuss major evidence readouts with other thought‑leaders.
  • Liaises with Hematology experts and centers to understand clinical levers and barriers to patient access in the context of clinical trials and upon commercial availability of the product.
Medical Engagement
  • Effectively collaborates and communicates with Intercontinental Thought Leaders to gain insights into the clinical landscape.
  • Engages in scientific and clinical conversation to ensure the development of a product/disease area-focused medical plan that translates into effective launch and Life Cycle Maintenance (LCM) activities.
  • Responsible for conducting evidence read‑outs with the most prominent institutions, e.G., pivotal top‑line data.
  • Engages with medical societies, Patient Advocacy Groups, and guideline discussions as appropriate.
  • Engage Hematology decision makers in selected Academic Medical Centers to help identify barriers and solutions to improve patient care and outcomes.
Required Qualifications & Experience
  • 5+ years of relevant experience.
  • MD from top clinical practice and hospital‑academic centers.
  • Proven record of developing high impact peer‑to‑peer relationships and influence with high impact Regional Thought Leaders.
  • Strong Hematology experience required:
    • Scientific or clinical area, patient treatment trends, clinical landscape.
    • Clinical trial design and process or pharma experience.
    • National and regional (Europe) healthcare and access environment.
  • Working in a scientific and/or clinical research environment.
  • Desired - Understanding of Intercontinental environment and needs.

This position requires approximately 50% travel.

Key Competencies DesiredScientific Agility
  • Ability to engage in a peer-to-peer dialog about data in a fair and balanced way.
  • Expert knowledge of clinical practice and evolving healthcare delivery models.
  • Ability to understand and critically appraise scientific publications.
  • Knowledge of clinical trial design and methodology, including Good Clinical Practices and ethical, governmental, and regulatory requirements.
  • Understands treatment paradigms and can frame information in a convincing way that resonates with physicians.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to articulate scientific and clinical data in an easy-to-understand manner to help HCPs best serve their patients.
  • Has a strong learning mindset and passion for science. Prioritizes staying current with the latest data.
Patient Centricity
  • Understands the patient journey and experience.
  • Able to adopt a patient-focused mindset, making patients a top priority.
  • Exhibits genuine care for patients.
Customer/Commercial Mindset
  • Winning Mindset: results-oriented, positive, resilient attitude, able to quickly adapt in an ever-changing environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive organizational performance.
  • Experience identifying, engaging, and cultivating relationships with TLs.
  • Demonstrated an ability to influence matrix organization and problem-solving mentality.
Teamwork/Enterprise Mindset
  • Ability to work independently and act as a team player by developing strong rapport and working relationships with external and internal stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of the regional healthcare and access environments.
  • Deep knowledge and experience of RWE.
  • Be a representative of BMS in all interactions with external stakeholders.
  • Holds a high level of integrity and good judgment, in order to navigate the requirements of the role effectively and compliantly in accordance with BMS policies and procedures.

If you come across a role that intrigues you but doesn’t perfectly line up with your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be one step away from work that will transform your life and career.

Uniquely Interesting Work, Life-changing Careers

With a single vision as inspiring as “Transforming patients’ lives through science™ ”, every BMS employee plays an integral role in work that goes far beyond ordinary. Each of us is empowered to apply our individual talents and unique perspectives in a supportive culture, promoting global participation in clinical trials, while our shared values of passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity bring out the highest potential of each of our colleagues.

On-site Protocol

BMS has an occupancy structure that determines where an employee is required to conduct their work. This structure includes site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design jobs. The occupancy type that you are assigned is determined by the nature and responsibilities of your role:

Site-essential roles require 100% of shifts onsite at your assigned facility. Site-by-design roles may be eligible for a hybrid work model with at least 50% onsite at your assigned facility. For these roles, onsite presence is considered an essential job function and is critical to collaboration, innovation, productivity, and a positive Company culture. For field-based and remote-by-design roles the ability to physically travel to visit customers, patients or business partners and to attend meetings on behalf of BMS as directed is an essential job function.

Supporting People with Disabilities

BMS is dedicated to ensuring that people with disabilities can excel through a transparent recruitment process, reasonable workplace accommodations/adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to Visit careers.Bms.Com/ eeo -accessibility to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement.

Candidate Rights

BMS will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, pursuant to applicable laws in your area.

Data Protection

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL), with support and guidance from peers and management, will serve as a scientific liaison to the medical / academic community and is responsible for establishing and maintaining relationships with Health Care Providers / Professionals (HCPs) to ensure the appropriate dissemination of clinical and scientific information regarding Vertex's compounds in a timely, ethical and stakeholder-focused manner.

The MSL will contribute to shaping the medical plan by providing external stakeholders' insights and contribute to the design and execution of the Medical Affairs strategy and plan.

  • Conceptual and practical knowledge of local and regional payers within the geography and understands the relationships between those plans and patient care delivery in the region
  • Assists clinical development / clinical operations by understanding IB content and presenting IB content and presenting IB material at SIV meetings, providing nominations for trial sites as requested, providing end of study data reviews with investigators as needed
  • With guidance from management, represents Vertex at medical congresses by providing scientific session / abstract coverage, booth staffing coverage, routine TL interactions, contributing to the daily and end of congress summaries
  • After initial guidance, independently performs and completes, in a timely manner, administrative tasks such as CRM entry, vehicle mileage reporting, expense reporting, calendar entries, trainings assignments, etc. and conducts all activities in compliance with Vertex Policy and Procedures
Knowledge and Skills
  • Ability to complete goals within allotted timeframes, and deliver high quality results
  • Ability to initiate, plan and complete projects in a constantly changing field-based environment
  • Ability to identify issues and create solutionsAbility to critically appraise and comprehend medical and scientific literature
  • Ability to effectively present clinical / scientific information in a credible manner in varied settings
  • Good knowledge and understanding of assigned geographic territory and healthcare regulatory environment
  • Ability to use Microsoft Office programs and to work in a matrix environment

  • Has working knowledge of local / regional payers within geography and the relationships between those plans and patient care delivery in the region
  • Fluent in English & Local Language (oral and written)
  • Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record
  • Ability to travel overnight up to 70%, depending on assigned geography;
    including occasional weekend travel
Education and Experience
  • Minimum requirement for advanced biomedical or life sciences degree (Masters, NP, PA)
  • Preference for terminal degree in the biomedical or life sciences (DO, MD, PharmD, PhD)
  • Requires a minimum of some years of experience as a MSL, or in other medical affairs roles in the pharma / biotech industry

description:
Feita de pessoas que transformam a educação

Todas as vagas da Arco são elegíveis para Pessoas com Deficiência.

No time Jurídico , você fará parte de uma equipe que apoia diretamente a área comercial e de relacionamento com escolas, atuando na análise, negociação e gestão de contratos. Você será responsável por propor melhorias nos processos contratuais, garantir segurança jurídica com agilidade e contribuir para a construção de fluxos mais eficientes e escaláveis.

Responsabilidades
  • Atuar como ponto focal jurídico para a área comercial e de relacionamento com escolas, oferecendo suporte na análise e negociação de contratos de prestação de serviços educacionais e/ou soluções digitais.
  • Elaborar, revisar e negociar instrumentos contratuais com escolas clientes, garantindo alinhamento entre termos jurídicos e as práticas comerciais da empresa.
  • Propor e implementar melhorias em processos contratuais, com foco em ganho de escala, clareza e agilidade no atendimento às áreas parceiras.
  • Desenvolver e manter modelos-padrão de contratos e aditivos, orientações práticas, minutas operacionais, playbooks e FAQs jurídicos voltados às áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar a construção de fluxos de contratação mais eficientes, interagindo com times como comercial, operações, onboarding, compliance, atendimento e tecnologia.
  • Participar da estruturação e/ou manutenção de ferramentas de gestão contratual (como CRMs, dashboards, repositórios ou plataformas de assinatura digital).
  • Acompanhar e resolver demandas contratuais do ciclo de vida do cliente: renovações, alterações de escopo, inadimplemento e outras ocorrências contratuais.
  • Apoiar treinamentos ou capacitações internas voltadas a times que atuam diretamente com escolas, promovendo melhoria da experiência contratual.
Qualificações Necessárias
  • Formação acadêmica: Graduação completa em Direito com OAB ativa.
  • Experiência profissional: Vivência com contratos empresariais em ambientes de médio ou grande porte, e atuação em parceria com áreas comerciais, operações ou relacionamento com clientes.
  • Perfil estruturante e organizador: capacidade de mapear gargalos, propor fluxos, implementar controles e criar materiais de apoio (ex.: modelos, FAQs, fluxo de atendimento, painel de visibilidade).
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas de forma pragmática e colaborativa, mesmo com informações incompletas ou cenários ambíguos.
  • Excelente comunicação (oral e escrita), com habilidade para interagir com públicos diversos – escolas, time comercial, operações, atendimento, etc.
  • Mentalidade de serviço e experiência do cliente interno e externo.
  • Domínio de ferramentas básicas de produtividade (ferramentas do Google) e vivência com ferramentas de workflow jurídico ou gestão de contratos (ou facilidade para aprender).
Desejável
  • Experiência com melhoria de processos ou legal operations.
  • Implantação de melhorias operacionais, novos fluxos, SLAs, padronização de modelos ou criação de playbooks contratuais.
  • Preferência por quem já precisou conciliar visão jurídica com execução prática e negociação direta com áreas de negócio.
  • Conhecimentos em gestão de dados contratuais.
  • Iniciativas de liderança ou coordenação informal de projetos jurídicos.
Benefícios
  • Auxílio alimentação e/ou refeição
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico
  • Vale transporte
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida
  • Auxílio creche
  • Cuidado com a saúde: parceria com a Wellhub e Zenklub
  • Incentivo à educação
  • Desconto em passagens aéreas
  • Parceria com plano de saúde para Pet
  • Acesso aos materiais didáticos Arco para filhos de colaboradores
  • Parcerias para MBA e Pós Graduação
Diversidade e Inclusão

#MaisDiversidade. Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossas pessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e com mais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial . Por isso, aqui na Arco, respeitamos e valorizamos a igualdade de direito, reconhecemos as singularidades e acreditamos que todas as pessoas podem contribuir para o nosso propósito. #VemPraArco

ANALISTA DE CONTRATOS

Descrição da Vaga

Essa posição será responsável por acompanhar o ciclo completo dos contratos, desde a elaboração e controle de requisições até o acompanhamento de execução, medição, faturamento e encerramento, garantindo conformidade técnica, financeira e regulatória.

  • Assegurar conformidade das contratadas às políticas de segurança e compliance da companhia.

  • Excel avançado.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de atuar com múltiplas interfaces.
  • Vivência com contratos de alta complexidade e gestão orçamentária.

Diferencial
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e ferramentas de análise de dados.
  • Experiência com políticas de compliance e segurança aplicadas à gestão contratual.
Oferecemos
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa‑auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio‑medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale‑presente, Vale‑transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.

description:
Job description

Na busca contínua por mentes criativas e apaixonadas por inovação, estamos à procura de indivíduos que desafiem os limites, que abracem o novo e tracem caminhos inexplorados rumo a um futuro promissor.

Com mais de 29 anos de expertise em Consultoria e Gestão de Projetos, somos uma referência nacional em Engenharia Consultiva, em constante expansão global. Com DNA de inovação, nos reinventamos e evoluímos.

Nossa equipe, formada por mais de 2,3 mil colaboradores, trabalha para impulsionar nossa empresa rumo a um futuro ainda mais relevante, global e digital até 2030. Se você se identifica com nosso propósito, vamos juntos imaginar um futuro e engenhá-lo?

Main responsibilities

Descrição sumária:

Responsável por atuar nas atividades relacionadas ao monitoramento dos resultados financeiros dos contratos, controle de custos e administração contratual, envolvendo administração de escopos, análise de pleitos e controle de prazos contratuais, bem como executar a medição dos contratos e serviços e verificar a conformidade das documentações contratuais apresentadas para liberação de pagamentos de contratadas.

Descrição detalhada:

  • Lançamento de Receitas: Efetuar o lançamento das receitas provenientes dos contratos, assegurando a correta contabilização e o cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Acompanhamento de Medições: Realizar o acompanhamento rigoroso das medições, verificando a conformidade com os termos contratuais e os projetos;
  • Gestão de Pendências: Gerenciar as pendências de faturamento, identificando as causas e propondo soluções para a resolução ágil dos problemas;
  • Faturamento: Efetuar o faturamento dos serviços prestados, emitindo as notas fiscais de acordo com os procedimentos internos e a legislação vigente;
  • Emissão de Notas de Débito: Emitir notas de débito quando necessário, justificando adequadamente os valores e os motivos da cobrança;
  • Elaboração de Relatórios: Elaborar relatórios periódicos sobre o desempenho dos contratos, destacando indicadores chave e identificando oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Auditoria de Boletins de Medição: Realizar a auditoria dos boletins de medição, verificando a exatidão dos cálculos e a consistência das informações;
  • Suporte a outras áreas: Prestar suporte a outras áreas da empresa em assuntos relacionados a contratos, como jurídico e financeiro.
Requirements and skills

Como requisito básico, você deve ter:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência sólida em processos de gestão contratual ou faturamento, com foco em serviços;
  • Conhecimento emlegislação tributária e normas contábeis;
  • Domínio do pacote Office, especialmente Excel;
  • Habilidade paraanálise de dados e elaboração de relatórios;
  • Organização, proatividade e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.

Você se destaca se tiver:

  • Conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Conhecimento emSAP;
  • Conhecimento emIA.
Additional information

Características da vaga:

  • Regime de contratação: Flex Office (Híbrido);
  • Local de atuação: Vitória/ES;
  • Horário de trabalho: 09h às 18h.

Benefícios contemplados na vaga:

  • Plano de saúde
  • Plano Odontológico

#VemSerMCA

Na MCA, consolidamos nossa posição como líderes em Consultoria, Auditoria e Gerenciamento de Projetos desde 2002. Pelo segundo ano consecutivo, recebemos o reconhecimento da revista 'O Empreiteiro' como a principal empresa na categoria de Projetos e Consultoria em todo o estado de Minas Gerais, além de nos orgulharmos de ocupar a quarta posição no Ranking Nacional. Nossa abordagem une engenharia, gestão e talento humano para conceber soluções criativas e impactantes. Além disso, mantemos o compromisso com a qualidade e a inovação, como evidenciado por nossa Certificação ISO 9001.

Quem Somos: Cultivamos uma cultura baseada em integridade, ética e excelência técnica. Operamos com transparência, enfrentando crises com resiliência e inovação. Nossa missão é atuar em engenharia consultiva, gerenciamento de projetos, auditorias e fiscalização, impactando positivamente pessoas e empresas.

O que Valorizamos: Faça parte de uma equipe que valoriza bem-estar, alegria e equilíbrio no trabalho. Buscamos profissionais comprometidos, que valorizam colaboração, interação e aprendizado contínuo. Na MCA, trabalhamos de forma colaborativa e todos torcem uns pelos outros.

Nossa Presença: Presentes em todo o Brasil, empregamos mais de 2 mil pessoas e atuamos em setores como Mineração, Siderúrgico, Infraestrutura, entre outros. Construímos um futuro sustentável e impactante.

Junte-se ao Time MCA: Se busca um ambiente acolhedor, que respeita as diferenças, estimula o progresso das pessoas e busca constantemente a inovação, #VemSerMCA. Junte-se ao time que transforma desafios em oportunidades. Na MCA, construímos juntos o futuro. Vem ser parte dessa comunidade!

E suas principais atividades serão:

  • Receber, analisar e controlar a documentação para elaboração de contrato.

Vem Ser Data!

A Data acredita no poder transformador das pessoas. Aqui, trabalhamos com excelência técnica, liderança, inovação e espírito de equipe, competências poderosas que guiam nossa atuação e evolução.

Se você procura por uma empresa com um time altamente especializado, excelente clima organizacional e parceira dos clientes na potencialização de seus resultados, estamos prontos para acompanhá-lo nessa jornada.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Realizar a gestão de contratos para serviços de reparos/reformas de motores e geradores em campo, desde o fechamento de pedidos, execução (interface com o cliente), faturamento até o vencimento de garantia, a fim de cumprir os prazos negociados com os clientes, com qualidade, margem, garantindo a satisfação e o potencial de novos negócios junto aos clientes.
  • Analisar criticamente o escopo de cada contrato, bem como os prazos negociados e demais informações para o atendimento dos requisitos dos clientes versus o orçado;
  • Liberar ordens de serviços para campo;
  • Elaborar cronograma e acompanhar a evolução dos contratos, bem como tomar e/ou recomendar as ações preventivas ou corretivas necessárias para a realização dos serviços programados;
  • Planejar e programar os serviços aprovados conforme contrato e escopo;
  • Convocar e conduzir reuniões para o início de cada projeto junto às demais áreas envolvidas, detalhando informações relacionadas ao cliente e ao escopo, a fim de alinhar detalhes relacionados o serviço, qualidade, recursos necessários, custos envolvidos, prazos, dentre outros, bem como interagir no planejamento para o andamento das etapas seguintes;
  • Convocar e conduzir reuniões de análise crítica, avaliando com as equipes as etapas do projeto para definição e/ou ajustes de cronograma, detalhar responsabilidades, itens críticos, dentre outros, bem como implementar, se necessário, ações preventivas ou corretivas para o atingimento dos objetivos propostos;
  • Redigir atas dereuniões internas ou externas, referentes aos contratos administrados;
  • Manter os clientes atualizados com informações do andamento dos projetos, através da elaboração de relatórios técnicos com detalhamento do status dos mesmos;
  • Buscar a eliminação de eventuais pendências internas ou do cliente, gerir reclamações e reivindicações, negociar acertos e ajustes de projetos e corrigir os desvios, a fim de obter a melhor sinergia operacional;
  • Contribuir paraa manutenção do custo orçado para cada projeto, avaliando com as equipes as alterações em função das necessidades buscando alternativas para evitar a variação nos valores previstos, por meio de ações preventivas ou corretivas;
  • Acompanhar e propor ações junto as equipes de campo quanto à qualidade dos serviços realizados, prioridades e prazos, buscando o cumprimento dos requisitos dos clientes;
  • Acompanhar obras in loco e realizar visitas aos clientes para alinhamento de contratos, escopos e serviços;
  • Manter controlesobre toda a documentação relacionada a cada contrato;
  • Providenciar asoperações finais para a entrega dos serviços, envolvendo liberação para faturamento e entrega de toda documentação técnica envolvida;

title: Pessoa Analista De Contratos - Cadastro De Beneficiários - Sede - Sede
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Desenvolver atividades administrativas de análise relacionadas à emissão de relatórios, conferência de documentos e suporte aos demais setores.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Emitir e analisar relatórios diversos no sistema para suporte geral à equipe de contratos (estatística do setor, controle de cartões, inclusão e exclusão de beneficiário, inadimplência de clientes, quantidade de beneficiários, PTU 1300, PTU A100 e PTU A200, etc.).
  • Gerar e conferir as cartas de inadimplência para eliminar cartas em duplicidade.
  • Gerar carta de inadimplência para clientes com maior criticidade.
  • Fazer o controle das cartas de inadimplência enviadas e recebidas pelo cliente.
  • Fazer a exclusão de clientes por inadimplência no sistema.
  • Acompanhar as solicitações feitas junto aos correios.
  • Fazer o cadastro em sistema da rede de prestadores para registro de produtos comercializados pela cooperativa (RPS - Registro de Produto de Saúde, ARPS - Adequesão de Registro de Produto de Saúde).
  • Acompanhar a emissão de cartões dos beneficiários, e dar as devidas tratativas sempre que necessário.
  • Analisar e fazer as devidas correções no CADU – Cadastro de beneficiários entre Unimed’s.
  • Dar suporte a equipe de ressarcimento ao SUS, bem como, extrair e gerar dados dos beneficiários para conferência e análise.
  • Analisar dados de beneficiários, que se tornaram ex-funcionários, bem como os valores da tabela que constam em sistema e fazer as devidas correções, sempre que necessário.

Referência em inovação, criatividade e respeito às diferenças, o Publicis Groupe é o maior grupo de comunicação do mundo e o que mais se valoriza no mercado.   • Conhecimento em DataViz (Looker, Power BI) e noções básicas de Python/BigQuery.

  • Familiaridade com Search, influenciadores e estratégias digitais.

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise (GWI, TGI, Monitor, etc.).

  • Liderar e supervisionar equipe de BI, promovendo desenvolvimento e inovação.

title: Creative Director | Talent Pool
description:
We are ARVORE, a startup in the virtual reality content creation scene. Our process emphasizes teamwork, agility, and multidisciplinarity. We are looking for a passionate and self-motivated person with a positive attitude and a genuine team player, who likes to share knowledge and is open to learning from others. We embrace problem solvers, those who aren't afraid to experiment and fail, and are ready to create something new.

ARVORE is looking to hire a technically adept, creative individual to complement our team. You will have the opportunity to work on innovative immersive and narrative-driven XR experiences, iterating and prototyping with a high level of creative freedom and with the opportunity to guide the direction of some of these endeavors.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Creative Directors are responsible for defining and nurturing the product’s vision, understanding the company’s strategic goals, and keeping everyone’s efforts focused towards the same direction.

Always aligned with the Production Manager and the Head of Studio, Creative Directors are responsible for defining and constantly reviewing the scope to keep projects on budget and on time.

This work also requires establishing the foundations of the experiences in all three pillars (artistic, systems, and narrative). The Creative Directors will articulate their vision, fostering an environment of collective creativity that inspires the team to come up with the best ideas, choosing the ones that fit into a coherent whole.

MAIN CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ACTIVITIES:
  1. Define a clear and reasonable creative vision for the product.
  2. Work closely with the Core Team members to develop their specific parts of the vision, tying together all artistic and technical elements.
  3. Constantly review the priorities and scope of each product delivery and/or milestone together with the Product Manager, considering the Value Proposition and goals of the product, but at the same time championing the product’s unique vision.
  4. Review production timelines, budget, and team performance with the Product Manager.
  5. Nurture and communicate the overall creative direction on an ongoing basis, inspiring the team through leadership.
  6. Be aware of internal and external QA results to direct creative decisions, ensuring the product meets main stakeholders' needs.
  7. Guarantee the consistency and quality of the product, ensuring creative cohesion between the user experience and company strategy.
  8. Serve as the spokesperson for the product’s vision within the team, for the press, and corporate management.
MUST HAVE:
  • Experience in a creative leadership position on at least one high-quality professional entertainment product/property shipped or delivered in industries such as XR, Games, Movies, Television, Advertisement, or Comics.
  • Positive leadership qualities.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to listen and communicate effectively (spoken and written).
  • Fluency in English.
  • Understanding and sensitivity to capturing the spirit of the moment (Zeitgeist).
  • Deep understanding of current trends in XR, gaming, and entertainment industries, influencing user expectations and behaviors.
  • Huge curiosity and openness to research and expand knowledge in virtual reality games, narratives, immersive art, etc.
NICE TO HAVE:
  • Familiarity with Google G Suite, Monday, Slack, and Github.
  • Fluency in Portuguese.
  • Previous experience with VR and AR content is desirable.
  • A passion for Games, Movies, TV, Art, Animation, Electronics, RPGs, Literature, Theater, Popular Culture, and narrative experiences.
  • Knowledge of other project management techniques.
  • Experience in a technology or content development environment.

description:

Creative Director- Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Join to apply for the Creative Director- Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package role at aramco

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Please note that this role is based in Saudi Arabia on a permanent, residential basis.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Senior Creative Director to join our Creative Design Unit with the Corporate Communications Administrative Area.

Creative Design Unit is a fast-paced, in-house creative organization that operates like a full-service advertising and design agency. Our work spans marketing campaigns, strategic storytelling, visual identity systems, design experiences across every touchpoint.

Your primary role is to set the tone and direction for the team, bringing clarity, energy, and inspiration to every brief.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on big ideas, with a visionary creative directions skill to lead and elevate our creative team, loves design at its highest standard, and has a proven ability to translate business objectives into powerful, meaningful creative work.

Key Responsibilities

As Creative Director, you will be responsible for the following:

  • Shaping the creative vision of the unit and ensuring it is consistently executed across all projects.
  • You will guide multidisciplinary teams through the development of concepts and campaigns, ensuring alignment with the organization’s strategic goals.
  • From brand development and design systems to large-scale integrated campaigns, your leadership will be central in delivering work that is engaging, cohesive, and impactful.
  • You will work closely with senior stakeholders to understand objectives, define creative strategies, and present ideas with clarity and conviction.
  • You will oversee the full creative process—from concept to execution—ensuring work meets the highest standards of quality and innovation.
  • A key part of your role will also involve mentoring creative talent, building a strong team culture, and fostering a space where original thinking thrives.
  • A minimum of 10 years of creative experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership role within a creative agency or in-house creative team.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating creative direction across branding, advertising, and digital campaigns is essential.
  • You should have deep knowledge of visual communication, typography, brand systems, storytelling, and design strategy, with hands-on experience in leading multi-channel creative work.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and presentation skills are required, along with a proven ability to manage and mentor a diverse creative team.
  • Proficiency in industry-standard design tools is expected, and familiarity with motion, video, or experiential media is a strong advantage.
  • A degree in design, visual communication, or a related field is preferred

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Creative Director
description:
Creative Director for Monks

Monks is looking to add another CD to its superband of creatives. In this role, you’ll provide our clients with creative decks, ideas and direction, bringing forth award‑winning products and campaigns for some of America’s leading technology brands. If you are the Don(na) Draper of the digital and social age, we’d love to pick your brain.

Role & Responsibilities
  • As a CD, life’s a pitch: you engage projects for a living and relay responsibilities to others once the ball is rolling in the right (creative) direction.
  • You’ll own the creative execution of clients, seeing them through from pitch to final delivery.
  • You’ll visit clients throughout the region, leading workshops and providing creative direction for any kind of project.
  • A strong focus on social content, script writing, and film production is a must.
  • You bring top‑notch production thinking to the table and provide creative consultation when it comes to the nitty‑gritty of cutting‑edge campaigns.
  • As a CD at MediaMonks, you’re part of the most awesome production agency on the planet, operating as ‘one office across 11 locations’ with an incredible in‑house team of 1200 Monks and counting.
Come Turn Concepts into Projects

MediaMonks is one of those (50) companies creative people would kill to work for. You’ll be part of a young, successful and crazy‑ambitious company that is determined to reach Mars before Musk. In addition to an unlimited supply of incredible coworkers, MediaMonks gets you a one‑of‑a‑kind company culture, amplified by all the awards. If you’re the one, we’d love to be the zero so we can make beautiful binary babies together.

Requirements
  • We’re looking to hire an all‑round concept developer with at least +4 years of CD‑level experience in advertising or production at the highest international level.
  • Make no mistake, this role requires you to put pen to paper and come up with buzzworthy ideas, and have the ability to present them in equally compelling decks.
  • You will take ownership for the entire campaign, providing strong leadership and direction throughout all stages of a project, including the management of a wider team of creatives, designers, and animators.
  • You know how to show leadership without a show of force, giving our in‑house teams a clear creative direction and ownership over their projects.
  • You can independently lead fast‑paced pitches but also love going the extra mile when painstakingly pushing running projects to perfection.
  • You’re a digital genius with an innate taste for the latest and greatest social platforms, digital technology, an instinct for snappy writing and a natural feel for visual design.
  • You’re confident leading different types of work spanning from digital and social campaigns to platforms and websites, hero films and TVCs, and installations.
  • For film‑based projects, it’s all about the story: you champion storytelling and are experienced working together with film directors on integrated projects.
  • In digital, the user experience is king, and so you should be a sovereign when it comes to shaping concepts that captivate and inspire.
  • With strong pitching and presentation skills, you can represent MediaMonks by showcasing our cases, capabilities and culture to clients.
  • As part of a global company operating as one team across time zones, you need to be able to successfully direct work at a distance.
  • You understand the process and politics of advertising inside out and know when to be pragmatic if that’s what it takes to keep things moving.
About Monks

Monks is the global, purely digital, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global marketing and technology services to accelerate business possibilities and redefine how brands and businesses interact with the world. Its integration of systems and workflows delivers unfettered content production, scaled experiences, enterprise‑grade technology and data science fueled by AI—managed by the industry’s best and most diverse digital talent—to help the world’s trailblazing companies outmaneuver and outpace their competition.

Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services. It has remained a constant presence on Adweek’s Fastest Growing lists (2019‑23), ranks among Cannes Lions’ Top 10 Creative Companies (2022‑23) and is the only partner to have been placed in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020‑24). In addition to being named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023), Monks has been recognized by Business Intelligence in its 2024 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Awards program in three categories: the Individual category, Organizational Winner in AI Strategic Planning and AI Product for its service Monks.Flow. Monks has also garnered the title of Webby Production Company of the Year (2021‑24), won a record number of FWAs and has earned a spot on Newsweek’s Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces 2023.

We are an equal‑opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.
